answers.core: It should be default as it improves working with subresources for anyone using them.
answers.workaround:
Every sub-resource can be created as its own root-resource, but that unecessarily clutters the project with files that are mostly only being used in one place anyway. 
But maybe it can be fixed with a few lines of script instead.

title: Improve sub-resource inspector (use same as at root-level)
